summary: Multiplayer house party Fun challenge for two players or more. Play with friends
description:
It's time to beat your friends in mini-games offline playing at the same time on the same device. Senior Games presents you this compilation of quick games for 1 2 3 4 people. 2 players, 3 players and up to 4 players at a time can enjoy a unique multiplayer experience.

Fun is assured with this collection of house party mini-games to play on the same mobile or tablet offline. Start the battle of 2 players, 3 players or up to 4 players. Have a great time with competitive multiplayer games. Many games in one and all you need is a smartphone or tablet and you can play offline.

In the cool multiplayer games offline from the house party games collection you can play with two players, but if you have more friends or family and you are many players you can challenge 3 players or 4 players. Have fun with this competitive multiplayer game. For those times when you are alone, play in 1 player mode against the bot and improve your skills to become the best. You don't need an internet connection to play. Play offline!

All the party games offline and fun pastimes in this board game have simple controls and simple rules that are easy to understand. Party games offline is ideal for people of all ages; the very young, adults and even senior players. With 2 3 4 players of any age, fun is guaranteed. Let the house party begin!

TYPES OF PARTY GAMES FOR 1 2 3 4 PLAYERS OFFLINE
Within this collection of socialization games you will find different challenges. All are two player games and have extra modes for 3 and 4 players. House party offline: challenge your friends or compete against your family now! 
- Free Fall
- Crazy Traffic
- Black Hole
- King of the island 
- Broken Platforms
- Jumping party
- Dance battle
- Duck water
- Sink in style

PARTY MODE 
Party mode for 1234 players offline is a combination of games from the different games that appear in the application. 2 players, 3 players or a group of up to 4 players can compete in house Party mode. A perfect option for those who like to try all the games offline and want to play with friends. Roll the dice, advance on the board and win the challenges - the winner of the competition will be the player who reaches the end of the course first! It takes two minutes to win! 

GAME MODES
In this multiplayer game offline, the more people you play with, the more fun the games are. But if you don't have anyone to play with, or you prefer to play against the bots, you can also play alone in the 1 player mode. 
- 1 player: if you want to play alone, this is your ideal option. You will have to face the AI and compete against it. It is an ideal way to improve your skills so you can beat your friends when you play with them later.
- Multiplayer mode for  2 3 4 players: with this offline competitive multiplayer mode you can play house Party with many friends at the same time on the same smartphone or tablet. You can play offline with one more person in 2 player mode, with 3 players if you are 3 friends and in 4 player mode if you want to play as a group with 4 people. Have fun with friends and family! It takes two minutes to win your rivals 🙌🏻

FEATURES 
- Multiplayer game for 1234 players.
- Multiplayer fun for people of all ages.
- Available in different languages.
- You can play offline 
- Fun and addictive!

ABOUT SENIOR GAMES - TELLMEWOW
Senior Games is a project of Tellmewow, a mobile game development company specialized in easy adaptation and basic usability which makes them ideal for seniors or young people who simply want to play an occasional game without major complications. If you have any suggestions for improvement or want to stay informed about upcoming games that we will publish, follow us on our social networks.
